reviewer_notes: Article One (RECOGNITION) recognizes the Association for "the following certificated or licensed employees" and enumerates "All full-time classroom teachers, including teachers of art, music, physical education, ... Certified Social Workers, and permanent replacements or permanent additions..."; both quotes are verbatim contiguous text and both answers describe the covered unit correctly. That clause sits on PDF page 5 (confirmed with pdftotext -f 5), whose printed footer reads "4" -- printed page = PDF page - 1 through this part of the document. B's page 5 is right; A's page 4 is the printed footer, not the PDF page, so A fails on page only. Minor imprecision in A's summary: the document includes only "Elementary Teaching Assistant Principals" and "Certified Social Workers" while excluding "all administrative personnel" and plain "social workers," but this was not enough to fail the value.
